surface_features: counter-argument comments quoting specific phrases from the original post
constructs.theoretical_construct: specific, targeted engagement with the OP's wording (quote-and-rebut)

features.name: any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly quote a specific phrase from the original post and, in that same comment, refute it?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Use title and argument only to check that a quoted phrase actually comes from the OP's post. Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly quotes (quotation marks or block-quote formatting) a specific phrase or sentence taken from the OP's title/argument, and (b) in that same comment disagrees with, rebuts or refutes that quoted phrase. Quote and refutation must be in the same comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Return 0 if no comment does, including quoting without refutation, quoting other sources, or refutation without quoting. Return 0 if the list is empty; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome updates and reports of the outcome as evidence; generic delta-rule discussion is not evidence either way.

h0: any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase has no association with the likelihood of view change.
h1: Discussions with any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase=1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with 0.
note: Operationalized as presence of at least one comment (any, not share/count) doing quote-and-refute. OLS on binary delta (linear probability); association only. OC_comments are current text with unknown timing and may include post-outcome material; no per-comment timestamps. Quotation marks alone do not prove the phrase is from the OP; the check against title/argument is required. Edited OP text may alter matching.
